Ber. 18ᵇ אֵימא לה לא׳ tell my mother; a. fr.—א׳ זקינה grandmother.

senses.gloss: trnsf. the flesh of a stone fruit.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 143a:11">Sabb. 143ᵃ</cite> <he>חזיין אגב אִימָּן</he> may be handled on account of the flesh (with which they were surrounded when Sabbath cause).—Pl. <cite ref="A01995"><he>אִימָּהָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A01994"><he>אִמְהָתָא</he></cite>.
Targ. Jer. XVI, 3; esp. the arch-mothers of the Israel. nation.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 17:9">Targ. Y. Ex. XVII, 9</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 82a:3">Kidd. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דינוקי</he> the mothers of school children. [V. also <cite ref="A01324"><he>אִימָּה</he> II</cite>.]
